literal_meaning: দুই অঙ্কের অর্ধেক অক্ষরে (দুই অক্ষরের অর্ধেক অক্ষরে)
figurative_meaning_en: in few words; briefly or concisely
similar_in_english: to make a long story short
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আড়াই অক্ষরে পুরো ঘটনাটা বর্ণনা করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He described the whole incident in a few words.
Say it briefly, I don't have time.
note: This idiom playfully refers to the brevity of expression, emphasizing efficiency in communication within Bengali linguistic traditions.
